About Metron 

 Metron is an employee-owned company dedicated to delivering innovative solutions for the most challenging national security problems. For over 40 years, our principled approach to problem-solving has yielded creative solutions at the intersection of advanced mathematics, computer science, physics, and engineering. Our people are leaders in their technical fields and are passionate about solving challenging problems. We look for individuals who share this same passion and can apply their experience in real-world settings.   

  

 
 
 
 Our Reston team is seeking a mid-level Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to help build and mature the testing infrastructure supporting production software for simulation, optimization, and decision support in mission-focused environments. This role is for someone who can develop robust test harnesses, mocking infrastructure, and automated and manual testing strategies. A successful candidate will also help integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines and improve software quality and reliability across Java, Rust, and TypeScript-based applications. The strongest candidates will bring solid software development fundamentals, hands-on experience with software testing and test infrastructure, and the technical judgment to build scalable, maintainable testing practices across a growing production codebase.

 Required Qualifications   

 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, applied math, or related field

 At least 3 years of industry experience

 Experience building test infrastructure including mocking and CI/CD pipelines

 Experience in software testing and test harness development 

 Experience designing automated and manual testing

 Software Development experience in Java, Rust or Typescript/React

 Ability to work effectively with researchers, engineers, and end users to translate technical concepts into usable software

 Familiarity with full-stack web application development in any frameworks/languages

 U.S. CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED; successful candidates will be subject to a security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information

 






 Desired Qualifications 

 
 
 
 
 Active DoD Security Clearance 

 Experience using ADO, Gitlab or similar CI/CD tools 

 
 Position Location:   Reston, VA 

 *The selected individual(s) will be required to work from the Reston, VA office 

 Perks and Benefits 

 
 Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance   

 Accompanying FSA and HSA options   

 Additional Voluntary Benefits    

 Paid Time Off    

 9 Observed Holidays and 2 Floating Holidays    

 Paid Parental Leave    

 Tuition Reimbursement   

 Relocation Assistance 

 Professional Development Reimbursement   

 Annual Salary Reviews    

 Profit Sharing    

 401(k) Traditional and Roth Options    

 Gym and Fitness Reimbursement    

 Employee Assistance Program    

 Employee Referral Program   

 





  

 Metron is an Equal  Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. It is the policy of the company to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religious, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. 

 VEVRAA Federal Contractor
